subject: Lawn mower pickup
text:
Hi,

Following up on the lawn mower I bought from you. I still need the extra fuel container and want to make sure it fits in my car before pickup. The back seat is folded flat, so height may be the issue.

If the delivery goes smoothly, I can take it tomorrow around noon. Please say when you are home.

Please leave the spark plug cover on if possible, since the garage shelf has small items. That would save me a search later.
